import React from 'react'; const DonationStats = ({ stats, dashboardStats, donors, loading }) => { // If we don't have stats yet, show loading state if (loading || (!stats && !donors.length)) { return (

Loading donation statistics...

); } // Use real data from API if available, otherwise calculate from props const donationsByType = stats?.donationsByType || { sheep: donors.filter(d => d.type === 'sheep').length, cow: donors.filter(d => d.type === 'cow').length }; const donationsByStatus = stats?.donationsByStatus || { pending: donors.filter(d => d.status === 'pending').length, sending: donors.filter(d => d.status === 'sending').length, done: donors.filter(d => d.status === 'done').length }; // Calculate percentages for visualization const totalDonations = donationsByType.sheep + donationsByType.cow || 1; const sheepPercentage = Math.round((donationsByType.sheep / totalDonations) * 100) || 0; const cowPercentage = Math.round((donationsByType.cow / totalDonations) * 100) || 0; const totalByStatus = (donationsByStatus.pending + donationsByStatus.sending + donationsByStatus.done) || 1; const pendingPercentage = Math.round((donationsByStatus.pending / totalByStatus) * 100) || 0; const processingPercentage = Math.round((donationsByStatus.sending / totalByStatus) * 100) || 0; const completedPercentage = Math.round((donationsByStatus.done / totalByStatus) * 100) || 0; return (
